CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of God as the CREATION? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing God as the CREATION.
   B. Apply the teaching of God as the CREATION with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use God as the CREATION to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say God as the CREATION has no place in daily life.

2. D — Apply the teaching of Name of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Apply the teaching of Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

5. A — Apply the teaching of Communicating to with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Places of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Apply the teaching of Plants and CREATION to; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of Handling the Bible BIBLE with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. A — Apply the teaching of The Bible BIBLE with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of Greatest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

16. (4 marks)
